lines.zh: 臺中東邊的山城新社，雲霧繚繞著層層河階台地。
lines.en: Xinshe, a mountain town east of Taichung, wrapped in mist over its river terraces.

lines.zh: 兩百年前，客家先民在這裡開墾，建起九個庄頭。
lines.en: Two centuries ago, Hakka settlers cleared this land and founded nine villages.

lines.zh: 相傳一百八十多年前，一名採樟工人上山躲雨。
lines.en: Legend says that over 180 years ago, a camphor worker sheltered from the rain.

lines.zh: 他發現一尊淋濕的媽祖神像，便將她迎回庄裡。
lines.en: He found a rain-soaked statue of Mazu and carried her home to the village.

lines.zh: 媽祖屢顯靈驗，九個庄頭決定輪流奉祀。
lines.en: Mazu answered many prayers, so nine villages agreed to host her in turn.

lines.zh: 山頂、新社、土城、畚箕湖……九庄輪流迎請媽祖。
lines.en: Shanding, Xinshe, Tucheng, Benjihu... nine villages take turns welcoming her.

lines.zh: 她不住廟宇，而是住進爐主家中的紅壇。
lines.en: She has no temple; she lives at the red altar in the host family's home.

lines.zh: 所以人們說，九庄媽是「有神無廟」。
lines.en: That is why people say she is "a goddess without a temple."

lines.zh: 誰來當爐主？信徒虔誠擲筊，請媽祖親自挑選。
lines.en: Who will host her? Devotees cast moon blocks and let Mazu choose.

lines.zh: 每年農曆初三到初七，擇一天出巡遊庄。
lines.en: Each year, on one day between the 3rd and 7th of Lunar New Year, she tours.

lines.zh: 天還沒亮，信眾就提燈集合，恭迎媽祖起駕。
lines.en: Before dawn, devotees gather with lanterns to escort Mazu out.

lines.zh: 神轎出發，鑼鼓與鞭炮聲響徹山間小路。
lines.en: The palanquin sets off; gongs, drums and firecrackers fill the mountain lanes.

lines.zh: 這是全臺灣每年最早登場的媽祖遶境。
lines.en: It is the earliest Mazu procession of the year in all of Taiwan.

lines.zh: 沿途信徒跪在路旁鑽轎腳，祈求一年平安。
lines.en: Along the way, devotees kneel to pass beneath the palanquin, praying for peace.

lines.zh: 輪值庄頭辦桌款待，八庄挺一庄，人情最濃。
lines.en: The host village sets out a feast; eight villages stand by one, full of warmth.

lines.zh: 吉時一到，香爐過爐交接，媽祖在新爐主家安座。
lines.en: At the auspicious hour, the incense burner passes on, and Mazu settles in her new home.

lines.zh: 二〇〇九年，九庄媽遶境登錄為臺中民俗文化資產。
lines.tts: 兩千零九年，九庄媽遶境，登錄為臺中民俗文化資產。
lines.en: In 2009, the procession was registered as a Taichung folk cultural heritage.

lines.zh: 水底寮退出後，新社庄多輪一次，仍守九年一輪。
lines.en: When Shuidiliao withdrew, Xinshe took an extra turn to keep the nine-year cycle.

lines.zh: 九年一輪，媽祖走過每一戶人家的門口。
lines.en: Every nine years, Mazu passes by the door of every family.

lines.zh: 沒有廟宇的高牆，她就住在人們的心裡。
lines.en: Without temple walls, she lives in the hearts of her people.

lines.zh: 兩百年的香火，一代接著一代，繼續走下去。
lines.en: Two hundred years of incense, passed from generation to generation, walk on.
